tldr: Neptune through the 6th house blurs work, health, stress, routines, and daily maintenance.
body:
When Neptune moves through your 6th house, it blurs the edges of work, health, stress, routines, chores, habits, exhaustion, and what has become hard to maintain. You may notice the condition of your days more clearly: what is sustainable, what is draining you, and what your body keeps trying to report.

Longing, sensitivity, confusion, compassion, avoidance, or idealization may be stronger. It can help you soften where life has become too rigid or overly defended.

The useful side is that this timing can make the next honest move easier to see. This is useful for adjusting a routine before it becomes a bigger problem.

The caution: Watch for believing the dream so completely that you stop checking the evidence. The risk is treating stress as normal just because you have learned how to keep functioning through it.

Neptune moves through this house for a long chapter. Keep the sensitivity, but stay honest about what is actually happening.
